description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class StoreBreadcrumbsTag that generates breadcrumb navigation URLs based on request attributes and tag parameters. It processes breadcrumb data to construct URL references for store navigation.

classes.name: StoreBreadcrumbsTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag for generating store breadcrumb navigation URLs based on breadcrumb data and request parameters.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Constructs breadcrumb URL reference string based on breadcrumb data and category ID, writes to JSP output.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference content string to extract category IDs as a list.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Marks the end of tag processing, continues JSP page evaluation.
